name: hustlentussle-frontend
description: Build tooling for the Hustle n' Tussle frontend (esbuild transform + tsc typecheck)

scripts.build: esbuild web/js/app.js web/js/router.js web/js/ytd.js web/js/explainers.js web/js/components/DebugTools.js --outdir=web/js/dist --outbase=web/js --sourcemap --target=es2020
scripts.watch: esbuild web/js/app.js web/js/router.js web/js/ytd.js web/js/explainers.js web/js/components/DebugTools.js --outdir=web/js/dist --outbase=web/js --sourcemap --target=es2020 --watch
